differences: Text A blights 1 first (a -1/-1 counter on a creature you control) and creates the Treasure only if that happens; Text B creates the Treasure first and puts the -1/-1 counter afterward, reversing the order.
Text A's blight is on a creature you control; Text B puts the -1/-1 counter on 'a creature chosen by you' with no control restriction.

Text A's 'you may' covers the whole blight-and-Treasure action; Text B's 'you may have this ability' is a different optional choice and its Treasure requires only that you control a creature, not that a blight was done.
